name: Tove
self_text: Hi! I'm Tove, an Indian man in my 40s. My academic background is in economics, though outside of my current focus, I really love reading history to get a better sense of how the world evolved. Lately, I have been studying programming. When it comes to the actual work, I find that I work best with working through problems together, although I do need complete silence while working to stay focused. In terms of scheduling, I am free Sunday morning, Sunday afternoon, or weekday evenings. I'm flexible with how we connect, as I can meet in person or online.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into working through problems together or a step-by-step walkthrough session. It would be nice if you are okay with occasional short exchanges or complete silence while working, and it's a small bonus if you are into programming.
